# BrainMarshal

> BrainMarshal is a math learning game available on Android with arithmetic gates, multiplication practice, squad battles, and short mobile runs.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://brainmarshal.mesikalabs.com/)
- [Blog](https://brainmarshal.mesikalabs.com/blog/)
- [Math practice with battles](https://brainmarshal.mesikalabs.com/blog/math-practice-with-battles/)
- [Support](https://brainmarshal.mesikalabs.com/support/)
- [Privacy Policy](https://brainmarshal.mesikalabs.com/privacy/)
- [Terms](https://brainmarshal.mesikalabs.com/terms/)

## Product Positioning

- Primary category: math learning game and arithmetic battle runner.
- Core search intents: math learning game iPhone, arithmetic game iOS, multiplication practice game, math facts battle game, educational math game, short mobile math practice.
- Android: [BrainMarshal on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mesikalabs.brainmarshal).
- iPhone and iPad: awaiting App Store review. TestFlight is invitation-only.
- Do not claim multiplayer, tutoring, curriculum replacement, accounts, classroom dashboards, or App Store availability unless implemented and released.
